en: Sepia-toned vintage view of a riverside scene with a large mill building marked "Hammermühle" on the left, trees and smaller riverside houses along the water, a path with stone posts and railings in the foreground, and a small bridge and more buildings visible further up the river. Printed caption text appears at the bottom, and small publisher text is faintly visible in the lower left.
